analytics.raw_text: Table 7 (printed Tabelle 7) gives the crystallographic data of crystal modification I: crystal system orthorhombic (printed orthorhombisch), space group Pna21, unit cell dimensions a = 31,1647(18) Å, b = 10,3522(6) Å, c = 5,5449(3) Å with α = 90° for all three angles, unit cell volume 1788,91(18) Å3, coordination number 4. Lines 545 to 553. Values are printed with the German decimal comma.

Calculated density, printed Dichte (rechnerisch), 1,637 Mg/m3 for crystal modification I, line 553. The German decimal comma reads as 1.637 Mg/m3. This is the density calculated from the crystal structure, not a pycnometric measurement.

notes: Same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S: identical atoms and bonds, differing only in the crystal lattice. It is not a distinct chemical entity, it is crystal modification I of tembotrione. Table 7 is analytical data only. Pna21 is a space group symbol and orthorhombic is a crystal system, not compounds. This table is what claims 1 and 2 recite for this modification. Referenced from paragraph [0017]. Tables 3 to 7 cover modifications I and II only, as paragraphs [0013] to [0017] at lines 83 to 94 state. Crystal modification III has no single-crystal data, no powder pattern and no unit cell anywhere in this document: it carries a melting point in [0012] at line 81, its Raman and infrared band lists in Tables 1 and 2, a preparation example at line 670, and nothing else. Taken with the duplication between Tables 5 and 6, only one of the three forms has a powder pattern that is both present and unambiguous.
